Observation outside the security rubric, for the reviewer or builder (P2, not blocking). In src/web/app/workbench/browser.ts (publish, lines 20-28) a snapshot entry is kept as the same object once its status is non-null. In src/web/app/data/api.ts (loggingFetch, lines 440-442) status is set before responseHeaders and responseBody are read. If another request's publish() runs in that window, the first request's snapshot is frozen with a status but a null responseBody, and is never refreshed. The log could then show a settled exchange with no body (HONEST-1). The wb-7-log-growth test can't see this. Consider keeping an entry as settled only once responseBody is non-null.

Remaining hygiene (P2, not raised): the request log is still uncapped for the life of the page. publish() is O(n) per exchange but no longer allocates for settled entries. It is a local debug log in the user's own browser, so the exposure is negligible.
